run.description: Final graded run with the expanded agent prompts, starting from a fresh reset
run.database: data/campus_customs_new.db (reset from data/campus_customs.db before the run)
run.model: gpt-6-luna via Portkey (API reported version gpt-6-luna-2026-09-22)
run.human_authorization: Elise in chat: 'approve #1 and #2 as Elise, go with 20% off'. Approve & pay was then clicked on the dashboard signed as Elise.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: CC-TEE-WHITE size S was out of stock (0). Restock vendor Bulldog Print Co was blocked by overdue invoice #501 ($840). Accounting filed approval #1, Elise approved it, and the invoice was paid. The follow-up released held reorder #1 (1 tee, expected 2026-09-05 if sent) and saved updated customer reply #6.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, routed Inventory, then Accounting, then Customer Service in sequence, and set waiting_approval with a note. On the follow-up it had Inventory re-check the vendor and Customer Service send updated facts, then set in_progress (the backend then marked it resolved).
agents.inventory: check_stock: S = 0, short 1. check_vendor_can_ship(1): blocked by invoice #501, 3 days overdue. draft_vendor_reorder for exactly 1 (held). Follow-up: the vendor can ship, and release_held_reorders(1) released draft #1 with arrival 2026-09-05.
agents.accounting: Checked cash ($3,400, $0 pending), approvals and open invoices, then filed request_payment_approval for invoice 501: approval #1, $840.00, 'leaves $2,560 if approved.'
agents.customer_service: Saved reply draft #2 (size S unavailable, timing unconfirmed). Follow-up: saved draft #6 with 'expected by September 5, 2026 if the reorder is sent today.' Nothing was sent.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: Lease 1 rent of $2,400 due 2026-09-02 was confirmed from the leases table. Accounting filed approval #2, Elise approved it, rent was paid, and lease next_due moved to 2026-10-02.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, sent Facilities, and confirmed the outcome (waiting_approval, then resolved after payment).
agents.facilities: get_lease(1): Chapel Street shop, Elm City Properties, $2,400, due 2026-09-02 (2 days, not overdue). The requester and note match the database. Checked cash ($3,400, $840 already pending) and handed the payment to Accounting. Set the ticket to waiting_approval.
agents.accounting: get_lease(1), get_cash_balance, list_approvals, then request_payment_approval for rent on lease 1: approval #2, $2,400.00. Showed $3,400 - $840 - $2,400 = $160 if both are approved.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Accounting priced 10% ($52.20/unit, $1,044) and 20% ($46.40/unit, $928) options above the $22 cost. Elise chose 20%. Only 8 of 20 size M are on hand. Reorder #3 for the 12 short was held, then released after invoice 501 was paid (arrival 2026-09-05 if sent). The final customer reply #7 states the approved price, 8 available now and the rest by Sept 5. No money moved.

agents.boss: Routed Accounting, then Inventory, then Customer Service, one at a time with no duplicates, and set blocked pending the human discount decision. It then carried Elise's 20% decision through and ran the follow-up.
agents.accounting: quote_bulk_price at 10% and 20% for 20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY M, and said a human must decide (needs_human). Decision run: verified $58.00 x 80% = $46.40, x 20 = $928.00, margin $24.40/unit ($488.00).
agents.inventory: check_stock: M = 8 of 20, short 12. check_vendor_can_ship(1): blocked by invoice #501. draft_vendor_reorder for exactly 12 (held). Follow-up: the vendor can ship, and draft #3 was already released (arrival 2026-09-05).
agents.customer_service: Draft #4 (8 available, pricing pending). Draft #5 (approved price, but the 'restock on hold' wording was stale and has been superseded). Final draft #7: $46.40 each / $928 total, 8 now, 12 by Sept 5 if the reorder is sent, asks whether they want the 8 now. Nothing was sent.
